Activity · History → Activity The owner lost track of three chats and a script collector they had deleted themselves; nothing could show it. Activity answers what changed, when, and from where for chats, collectors, actions, batches, the queue, connections and settings. It lives under History as a fourth sub-item, next to Jobs, Ask chats and Actions: History is where the app already shows what happened, and where a missing chat is looked for first. Calm by default: one line per entry, day headings, faint “time · source”, colour only for failures. The detail shows what was there and how to get it back: Restore from Distill’s trash (deleted chats and collectors, 30 days), Show in Finder for queue files in the macOS Trash, or why nothing was kept. Never secrets or content: scripts appear as their size and line count. Core, API (GET /v1/activity) and CLI (distill activity) are built; this UI is not.
